patterns: Kailasa temple, Ellora -> Krishna I / Rashtrakutas is by far the most repeated fact across PSCs; trap options Krishna III, Govinda III, Dantidurga.
Founder Dantidurga (vs Amoghavarsha/Dhruva) and Amoghavarsha born in a military camp are standard single-fact questions.
APPSC uses wrong-pair format (Krishna III - Ellora trap) and literature angles (Pampa as Telugu-origin Adikavi, Kavirajamarga), plus Arab term Balhara.
Takkolam (Chola vs Rashtrakuta) and Ellora's Buddhist-Hindu-Jain coexistence recur as one-liners.
App leans heavily on multi-statement items on Vengi wars and court poets - deeper than PYQs but with a valid AP tilt.
